text:
keira: CISO asked to cut eu-west audit egress costs. Suggested approach: sample noisy keystore/enrichment events but keep auth/grant events full. Need quick ops/telemetry sync.

mano: Important: last time sampling masked intermittent KMS timeouts and delayed GPU node joins. We need canary + auto-revert.

pavan: Proposal: eu-west-1a canary at 50% for 48h, synthetic decrypt probe every 30s, auto-revert to 100% if probe fails 3x in 5m or `keystore_decrypt_error_rate` > 0.35%. Keep events with fields user_token, grant_id, cross_account unsampled.

ops-oncall: Runbook stub: snapshot current raw exports to s3://audit-hot/eu-west/pre-sample-<ts>, patch configmap to set sampling, deploy prometheus rule + webhook for rollback. CLI toggle: `kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch cm audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-1a.keystore.sampling":"0.5"}}'`. Will test rollback end-to-end in staging.

keira: Also ask infra to test exporter compression (snappy) + dedupe first; if that yields >25% reduction we can reduce sampling severity.

sec-bot: Ticket created SEC-2026-555. Assignees: keira (owner), ops-oncall (runbook), pavan (telemetry). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-555

mano: Agreed. Action items: pavan -> prometheus + dashboard + auto-revert webhook; ops-oncall -> snapshot + runbook + staging test; infra -> exporter bench. Meet 0900 UTC to approve canary.
